metadata.title: Monochromatic Red Portrait with Graffiti Typography

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, monochromatic red portrait of a tattooed man in profile, featuring a gritty film grain texture and stylized graffiti-inspired lettering positioned to the left of the subject.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject integrated into the background through shared monochromatic red hue
High-contrast shadows defining the subject's form and tattoos
White graffiti text acting as a sharp focal point against the red field
Vertical numbering along the right edge providing a structural counterweight
coreInvariants: Uniform red color cast across all elements
Heavy film grain or noise texture
Tattoos visible on neck, chest, and arms

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered horizontally in the lower half, occupying approximately 40% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face in profile and the white graffiti text to its left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the white text, moves right to the subject's face, then down through the tattoos, and finally to the vertical numbers on the far right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive red negative space in the upper half creates a sense of atmosphere and focus.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep dark red/black (shadows and tattoo details)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation with compressed value range, relying on shadow depth for form.

letterConstructionRules: Varying line weights mimicking spray paint or marker
Horizontal orientation for main text; vertical for metadata
characterSpecificRedesigns: Initial character features a sharp, arrow-like extension
Final character has a long, sweeping tail
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-energy gestural display text paired with utilitarian vertical numbering.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the aggressive, hand-drawn energy of the original lettering.
Captures the sharp, angular, and street-inspired look.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a monochromatic red portrait of a man in profile from the chest up. He should have short hair and visible tattoos on his neck and chest. Apply a heavy, gritty film grain texture across the entire image. Use high contrast to define the shadows of the tattoos and facial features against the red background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom white graffiti-style lettering to the left of the subject's face. The lettering should be sharp and interlocking. Add a vertical column of numbers (1-5) in a simple sans-serif font in the top right corner, rotated 90 degrees.

verificationChecks: Is the entire image monochromatic red?
Is the film grain texture prominent?
Is the main text in a white graffiti style?
Is the subject in profile facing left?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the red is vibrant and not muddy.
Check that the grain doesn't obscure the tattoo details too much.
Verify the white text pops against the red background.
Confirm the vertical text is correctly aligned to the right edge.
recipe.reuseFormula: Monochromatic Red + Gritty Grain + Profile Portrait + Graffiti Display Text
